name: Stellenbosch
terms: Wine of Origin, region, district, ward, estate

South Africa's appellation system since 1973, nested from regions down to districts and wards. A ward is roughly a European appellation. An estate wine may come from neighboring farms farmed and made together.
A red blend with 30 to 70% Pinotage, set by the industry rather than by law. Since the 2019 vintage Pinotage should be its largest part.
keyfacts: Stellenbosch's winemaking tradition goes back to the end of the 17th century, and it held about 13% of South Africa's wine grape vineyards in 2025.
The district is ringed by the Helderberg, Simonsberg and Stellenbosch Mountains, with deep, well-drained soils.
A southeasterly wind called the Cape Doctor blows across the southwestern Cape in spring and summer, holding back vineyard disease and lowering temperatures by several degrees.

notes: Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon is noted for heavy, full-bodied wines.

blurb.text: A district in the Coastal Region of the Western Cape, containing wards such as Banghoek, Bottelary, Devon Valley, Jonkershoek Valley and Simonsberg-Stellenbosch. Cabernet Sauvignon leads plantings at 20%, followed by Sauvignon Blanc, Merlot and Shiraz.
